entry.name: launchers
entry.label: Pinned apps, in order. Launcher URLs as used by the task manager (applications:ID.desktop, preferred://browser, file paths). Entries whose app is not installed are hidden.

entry.name: launcherFallbacks
entry.label: PRIMARY=FALLBACK pairs of launcher URLs. When PRIMARY is pinned but not installed, it is replaced by FALLBACK once (if FALLBACK is installed and not pinned yet).

entry.name: magnify
entry.label: Magnify icons on hover (48 px icons grow up to 62 px, neighbours to 54 px).

entry.name: magnifiedSize
entry.label: Size of the icon under the pointer when magnification is on, in logical pixels.

entry.name: showTooltips
entry.label: Show the name pill above the hovered item.

entry.name: colorVariant
entry.label: Colours: 0 = follow the Plasma style, 1 = dark, 2 = light.

entry.name: searchAction
entry.label: What the Search button opens: 0 = KRunner, 1 = the application launcher.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentDesktop
entry.label: Show only windows on the current virtual desktop.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentActivity
entry.label: Show only windows on the current activity.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentScreen
entry.label: Show only windows on the screen of the dock.

entry.name: minimizeActiveTaskOnClick
entry.label: Clicking the active app minimizes it.

entry.name: downloadsFolder
entry.label: Folder shown by the Downloads stack. Empty means the XDG download folder.

entry.name: tabletTile
entry.label: App tile size in tablet posture (TABLET 4.4: 56 px; 48 keeps more room for apps)

entry.name: splitRequest
entry.label: Other shell parts ask the dock to split the screen: "left|right:nonce:app-id.desktop". The dock moves the app in use to the other half, starts or activates the app (kstart when the dock does not have it) and tiles it when it is active.

entry.name: activateRequest
entry.label: The snap KWin script's "Plasma Fusion: Activate Dock Entry N" shortcuts ask the dock to activate its app N: "N:nonce" (Plasma 6.8 no longer passes plasmashell's task manager entries to the dock)

entry.name: tabletStripHeight
entry.label: Height of the tablet bottom strip: written by the plasmafusion-tablet KWin script, 20 px snapped to whole device pixels at the screen's scale (21 at 4/3)

entry.name: homeIndicator
entry.label: Show the home indicator pill on the tablet bottom strip (the settings module's switch; the 20 px strip itself stays)

entry.name: tabletRecents
entry.label: Recent apps after the pinned ones in tablet posture, most recently used first (TABLET2 N2: iPadOS shows three; 0 shows none)

entry.name: tabletShowDownloadsTrash
entry.label: Show Downloads and Trash in tablet posture (landscape only)

entry.name: powerTier
entry.label: Written by plasma-fusion-powerfx: 0 full (3 start-up pulses), 1 saver (1), 2 critical (none)

entry.name: debugAction
entry.label: Testing only: run one action and clear the key. Values: start, search, overview, downloads-menu, trash-menu, close-menu, configure, dump-targets (logs every target's rectangle), add-desktop:ROW, badge:ROW:COUNT:PROGRESS, menu:ROW, activate:ROW, new:ROW.

entry.name: debugPointerX
entry.label: Testing only: pretend the pointer rests over the dock at this screen x coordinate (-1 = off). Runs the same code as real pointer motion.

entry.name: debugHoverIndex
entry.label: Testing only: force the pointer onto this task index (-1 = off) so that screenshots show the magnified state and the name pill.
